comment: Single source for the Step 0 probe's pinned parameters (claude-reply-9b04ad1 sec.3 + sec.6). The capture runs the calibrated teacher build (search_s3.php = search_s2.php 85490e8e + the uncontested capture hook, fixtures/gen_search_s3.py) in capture mode: raw v10 plays, no picks applied. The offline eval reuses s1_eval_main.php byte-identical at the eval tuple (the calibrated search machinery, k=25). Labels reuse s2_label_main.php byte-identical at the round-9 label tuple. Seed bases: eval 30055001 + shard x 10^8 (value-disjointness vs every prior family by the shared lattice, proven by enumeration in fixtures/fx_seed_clearance.py at the planned counts); labels 70055001 + shard x 10^8, RANGE-disjoint from every prior family at the planned counts (prior span tops: Stage 3 family 50055001 span top 69,091,039 at <=176 jobs/shard; round-8 families 555001/777001 span tops ~58.5M at 547 jobs, W<=100; Stage 0/1/2 families all < 27M) with the label shard cap of 256 jobs enforcing span <= 27,036,278 (top 97,091,279 < 10^8); fix pass: planned label counts enlarged for the z > 1.0 uncontested SUPERSET (class (a) + the (1.0, 1.5] diagnostic class + the contested band): planned_jobs_total_max 160, planned_jobs_per_shard_max 256 == the enforced cap, so the cap enumeration in fx_seed_clearance.py covers the enlarged plan unchanged. Game seeds: capture 24001-24090 (seat 1: 24001-24045, seat 2: 24046-24090), extensions in 10-game blocks from 24091; checked disjoint from 1001-1200, 2001-2200, 8001-8200, 9001-9200 (RESERVED, untouched), 10001-10400, 21001-21040 (+ the Stage 1 extension range 21041-21100), 22001-22100, 23001-23200.

eval.screen: none -- full k=25 on every snapshot (see the package doc sec.5: a k=10 screen's miss probability on borderline tail states biases the tail-rate estimand, the probe's headline number, by a model-dependent factor)

classes.contested_band: contested states whose offline-eval z lies in (band_lo, band_hi] -- the fires a margin of band_lo would add
classes.uncontested: uncontested states whose offline-eval statistic would fire at the CURRENT margin (uncontested_margin) -- the population a threshold build would newly search under today's decision rule
classes.uncontested_diag: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY (fix pass, claude-reply-402c92f sec.3/F2): uncontested states whose z lies in (uncontested_diag_margin, uncontested_margin] -- the uncontested superset below the class-(a) margin; labeled and reported (counts, edge) but EXCLUDED from the threshold per-game gain and from the decision rule

report.decision_rule: A lever is BUILDABLE iff its predicted per-game gain's one-sided 95% lower bound (game-clustered, from the label reads) exceeds 0. If exactly one lever is buildable, recommend it. If both are, recommend the one with the higher lower bound; if the lower bounds are within each other's two-sided 95% CI, recommend the cheaper (the margin: it adds no searches). If neither is buildable, recommend NO Step 1 build.

step2_bar.note: fix pass (claude-reply-402c92f sec.3): the registered Step 2 two-sample bar -- PASS iff (gain_new - stage3_gain) / sqrt(SE_new^2 + stage3_gain_se^2) >= z_one_sided, SE_new at step2_games; probe_report prints each lever's predicted power against this bar as INFORMATIONAL only
